How to Choose an Interior Designer in Visakhapatnam

A practical way to shortlist, compare and choose the right designer for your Vizag home.

Home / Guides / How to Choose an Interior Designer in Visakhapatnam

By the Manzil Homes design team · Visakhapatnam

Choosing an interior designer is choosing a partner for several months and a large part of your savings. Here is a simple method to choose well.

Step 1: Get clear on your needs

Before calling anyone, list what you want done: full home or a few rooms, new apartment or renovation, must-have features, Vastu requirements, move-in date and a comfortable budget range.

Step 2: Build a shortlist of three

Look at Google reviews, Instagram and websites, and ask friends who recently did their homes. Prefer designers who show real, finished projects in Vizag.

Step 3: Meet them and visit their studio

A studio visit tells you a lot: how organised they are, the quality of their samples and whether they listen.

Step 4: Compare drawings and BOQs, not just totals

Ask each designer for a layout and an itemised BOQ for the same brief. Compare materials, hardware brands, board grades and what is included. A lower total often means lower specifications.

Step 5: Check execution and timelines

Who executes the work? How is progress tracked? What happens if there is a delay? Design-build firms remove the gap between designer and contractor.

Red flags

  • A single-line quote with no specifications
  • Pressure to pay a large advance immediately
  • No 3D or drawings before work starts
  • Vague answers about materials and hardware
  • No finished projects or reviews you can verify

Frequently Asked Questions

How many designers should I compare?

Two or three is enough to compare fairly without getting overwhelmed.

Should I choose the lowest quote?

Compare specifications first. The lowest total often uses cheaper boards, hardware or finishes.
